judge_separation.requirement: The semantic judge must not share the critic's model: a named human reviewer judges every semantic item, or a judge from a different provider does, with identity and prompt digest recorded.
excluded_as_judge: any model or session with repository access, and any model of the critic's family
judge_separation.how_established_becomes_true: Only in a successor profile file with this schema, frozen and committed before sealing, whose design_id is q01-release-v4, whose judge_separation.established is true and whose judge_separation.judge is {identity, prompt_digest, option} with option human_reviewer or other_provider. Its path and sha256 enter the pre-dispatch manifest; the verifier loads its bytes, checks the sha256 and the design id, derives judge separation from it, and requires judge.identity and judge.prompt_digest to equal run_identity.judge_identity and run_identity.judge_prompt_digest and every judged result's judge. A caller never supplies judge separation. Never set in place.

currently_available.consequence: release-v4 cannot execute until a separate judge is arranged in a successor profile

v3_error_independence.why: release-v4, like release-v3, has no generation path, so the item-level linking of generation-path errors and critic errors that verification.md section 6 requires cannot be observed; the tolerated joint-failure level and required precision are also not set by the owner. The verifier derives unverified for every release-v4 suite record from this design, never from the caller or the record.

fixed_now.task_and_error_scope: Q01-family critic judgments on design candidates: criteria Q1-Q8 and the six boundary classes
fixed_now.comparison_baseline: the same critic configuration with the empty lens pack (no_lens)
fixed_now.joint_error_definition: an item where the generation path's output has the defect and the critic misses it on the same item, and, separately, an item without the defect that the critic rejects; the two never share a denominator
known_confounders: shared model and training data between generator and critic
materials authored in one project style
fixed_now.analysis: descriptive counts with real denominators; a confidence interval only when its sample and dependence assumptions hold, otherwise counts and limits only

v3_error_independence.stop_and_exclusion: exclusions only before the first dispatch, with the reason recorded; after the first dispatch a disputed case makes the suite incomplete

metric_labels.joint_error: a generation-path defect missed by the critic on the same item (a V3 metric; needs a generation path, which release-v4 does not have)
metric_labels.judge_disagreement: a judge verdict differing from the sealed expectation (reported, never a joint error)

v3_error_independence.becomes_verified: only under a later frozen design that has a generation path, fixes the owner-set tolerated joint-failure level, sample size and precision, binds criticism verdicts to the critic configuration digest, is declared in the product gate's V3_VERIFYING_DESIGN_IDS after an independent audit, and has a run that meets it

not_claimed: a universal independence threshold or score
that a separate judge makes errors statistically independent
